application.name: YOLO26 Detection
application.description: Detects objects with holoscan-yolo26's Yolo26DetectionOp, or segments them with Yolo26SegmentationOp, in synthetic frames, JPEG and PPM files or a live V4L2 webcam; checks, prints and times the detections and masks, and can draw them over the frames in a HoloViz window or render them offscreen.

changelog.1.0.0: Initial release: the holoscan-yolo26 demo, with synthetic, JPEG/PPM and V4L2 webcam image sources; a HoloViz display with boxes and labels; a report with ground truth, expected detections, latency and annotated PPM output; the module's stub model for model-free runs.
changelog.1.1.0: Segmentation: --task segment runs Yolo26SegmentationOp, with the module's stub segmentation model or YOLO26n-seg; masks checked against synthetic truth, printed and drawn into written images; Yolo26SegmentationOverlayOp in the display; an offscreen HoloViz render whose every frame is checked; the ci mode segments.

hardware.name: NVIDIA GPU
hardware.description: A CUDA-capable GPU supported by the Holoscan SDK.

hardware.name: Webcam
hardware.description: A V4L2 camera offering YUYV, for the camera mode, which also needs a display.

data.name: YOLO26n and YOLO26n-seg (Ultralytics, AGPL-3.0)
data.description: Not part of this repository. The module's tools/prepare_model.py downloads the pinned weights and exports them to ONNX with the separately installed Ultralytics tool (--task segment for YOLO26n-seg). Needed by the demo, files, camera and segmentation modes only.

data.name: COCO val2017 image 000000039769
data.description: A sample image that prepare_model.py downloads for the demo and the real-model tests.

demo.description: Detect objects in the prepared sample image with YOLO26n, 300 times, printing its detections once and the latency per frame.

files.description: Detect objects in each JPEG and PPM image in the data directory once with YOLO26n, printing the detections and writing each image with its boxes drawn to the build directory.

camera.description: Live webcam with detections drawn over it; needs /dev/video0, a display, and the prepared model.

segmentation.description: Segment the objects in each JPEG and PPM image in the data directory once with YOLO26n-seg, printing the detections with the size of each mask, and writing each image with its masks and boxes drawn to the build directory.

segmentation_camera.description: Live webcam with instance masks and detections drawn over it; needs /dev/video0, a display, and the prepared segmentation model.

ci.description: Finite headless check without downloads: 30 synthetic BGR8 frames through TensorRT with the module's stub segmentation model, which stands in for YOLO26n-seg; every detection checked against the frame's known ones, every mask against its rectangle and the label image against the masks.
